Here is a comprehensive review of the **SpotifyPlus (`Plus`)** repository focused on **UI smoothness, frame-rate stability, startup speed, and UX reliability**, ordered from highest to lowest user-visible impact.

---

### 1. Critical UI Freezes & Main-Thread Stutters

1. **Context Menu Open Freezes the Entire UI Thread (`CountDownLatch.await()` on network call)**
   - **Location:** [NewContextMenuHook.java](file:///C:/Users/wmako/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/Plus/app/src/main/java/com/lenerd46/spotifyplus/hooks/NewContextMenuHook.java#L337-L377)
   - **Problem:** `updateLastFmHeader()` runs inside the `ContextMenuViewModel` constructor hook on the main thread. It spawns a raw `Thread` to query `ws.audioscrobbler.com` and calls `latch.await()` (with no timeout) on the UI thread. Whenever Last.fm is configured and the user opens a context menu, Spotify completely freezes until the HTTP call finishes or times out.
   - **Fix:** Cache scrobble counts in an `LruCache<String, String>` (and pre-fetch for the currently playing track when the track changes), or update the header asynchronously when the response arrives instead of blocking the constructor. At minimum, never block the main thread on network I/O.

2. **Tapping a Lyric Line to Seek Runs Uncached DexKit Search + `blockingGet()` on the UI Thread**
   - **Location:** [BeautifulLyricsHook.java](file:///C:/Users/wmako/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/Plus/app/src/main/java/com/lenerd46/spotifyplus/hooks/BeautifulLyricsHook.java#L2110-L2122)
   - **Problem:** Every time the user taps a lyric line, `seekClickListener` calls `bridge.findMethod(...)` on the main thread (scanning DEX methods) and then invokes `blockingGet()` synchronously on the returned RxJava `Completable`.
   - **Fix:** Resolve and cache `seekMethod` once during hook initialization, and subscribe asynchronously (or run `subscribe()`) instead of `blockingGet()`.

3. **Loading Lyrics Runs a DexKit Class Search on the UI Thread Every Time**
   - **Location:** [BeautifulLyricsHook.java](file:///C:/Users/wmako/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/Plus/app/src/main/java/com/lenerd46/spotifyplus/hooks/BeautifulLyricsHook.java#L1659-L1685)
   - **Problem:** Inside `handler.post(() -> ...)` on the main thread, `bridge.findClass(...)` is executed on every lyric load to find the player state constructor instead of caching `Constructor<?>` once.

4. **Experimental `TestingHook` Is Active in Production (`XposedLoader.java`)**
   - **Location:** [XposedLoader.java](file:///C:/Users/wmako/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/Plus/app/src/main/java/com/lenerd46/spotifyplus/XposedLoader.java#L165) & [TestingHook.java](file:///C:/Users/wmako/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/Plus/app/src/main/java/com/lenerd46/spotifyplus/hooks/TestingHook.java#L47-L96)
   - **Problem:** `new TestingHook().init(lpparam, bridge)` is unconditionally enabled. It hooks `LayoutInflater.inflate` across the entire app, attaches an `ExoPlayer` + `TextureView` to `ui_holder_content`, never releases prior `ExoPlayer` instances when `activePlayer = new ExoPlayer.Builder(context).build()` is overwritten ([TestingHook.java](file:///C:/Users/wmako/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/Plus/app/src/main/java/com/lenerd46/spotifyplus/hooks/TestingHook.java#L177)), and scrapes iTunes/Apple Music on raw threads.
   - **Fix:** Disable `TestingHook` in `XposedLoader.java` (or gate it behind a developer preference and properly release `ExoPlayer`).

---

### 2. Animation & Scrolling Jank (60–120Hz Hot Paths)

5. **Lyrics Update Loop Floods the Main Thread with Hundreds of `View.post()` Runnables & Per-Frame `Spline` Allocations**
   - **Location:** [BeautifulLyricsHook.java](file:///C:/Users/wmako/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/Plus/app/src/main/java/com/lenerd46/spotifyplus/hooks/BeautifulLyricsHook.java#L2438-L2494) & [SyllableVocals.java](file:///C:/Users/wmako/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/Plus/app/src/main/java/com/lenerd46/spotifyplus/beautifullyrics/entities/SyllableVocals.java#L343-L404)
   - **Problem:**
     - `BeautifulLyricsHook.updateProgress` uses a background `Thread.sleep` loop instead of `Choreographer.FrameCallback`, causing frame drift against VSYNC.
     - On **every frame**, `SyllableVocals.updateLiveTextState` calls `getSpline(...)` 3 times per active syllable/letter ([SyllableVocals.java](file:///C:/Users/wmako/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/Plus/app/src/main/java/com/lenerd46/spotifyplus/beautifullyrics/entities/SyllableVocals.java#L345-L347)), using Java Streams (`stream().map().collect()`) and allocating `ArrayList`s + `Spline` objects for static constant control points (`scaleRange`, `emphasisedScaleRange`, `yOffsetRange`, `glowRange`).
     - Worse, `updateLiveTextVisuals` ([SyllableVocals.java](file:///C:/Users/wmako/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/Plus/app/src/main/java/com/lenerd46/spotifyplus/beautifullyrics/entities/SyllableVocals.java#L378-L396)) calls `syllable.view.textView.post(() -> ...)` and `letter.view.post(() -> ...)` for **every single word and character on every frame**, flooding the main thread `MessageQueue` with hundreds of `Runnable` objects per second.
   - **Fix:**
     - Precompute the 4 static `Spline` instances as `private static final Spline` constants in `SyllableVocals`.
     - Drive lyrics progression with `Choreographer.getInstance().postFrameCallback(...)` on the UI thread (calculating only the lightweight interpolations on the UI thread or applying all view property updates in a single batch per frame with zero `View.post()` allocations).

6. **Per-Frame `LinearGradient`, Array, and `String` Allocations Inside `GradientTextView.onDraw()`**
   - **Location:** [GradientTextView.java](file:///C:/Users/wmako/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/Plus/app/src/main/java/com/lenerd46/spotifyplus/beautifullyrics/entities/GradientTextView.java#L33-L69)
   - **Problem:** Every frame a word or letter is sung, `setProgress()` / `updateShadow()` invalidates `GradientTextView`. Inside `onDraw()`, it calls `getText().toString()`, `paint.measureText(...)`, allocates `new int[]{...}`, `new float[]{...}`, and constructs a `new LinearGradient(...)` on every frame.
   - **Fix:** Create a single unit-width `LinearGradient` (and a reusable `Matrix`) when colors change, cache the measured text width when text or size changes, and simply translate/scale the shader in `onDraw()` via `shader.setLocalMatrix(shaderMatrix)`.

7. **Per-Frame Allocations & Always-On `OnPreDrawListener` in `ImmersiveAnimatedArtwork`**
   - **Location:** [ImmersiveAnimatedArtwork.java](file:///C:/Users/wmako/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/Plus/app/src/main/java/com/lenerd46/spotifyplus/hooks/ImmersiveAnimatedArtwork.java#L225-L313)
   - **Problem:**
     - Both `layer.draw(Canvas)` (lines 232–234) and `fade.onDraw(Canvas)` (line 254) allocate `new LinearGradient(...)` and `new PorterDuffXfermode(PorterDuff.Mode.DST_IN)` during drawing instead of caching them on size change (`onSizeChanged`).
     - `Surface` registers a `ViewTreeObserver.OnPreDrawListener` (lines 291–312) that stays attached and runs before every frame on the Now Playing screen even when no animated artwork is playing.

8. **Full View-Tree Traversal on Every Layout Pass & Dual Software Canvas Sampling in `AnimatedThemeBackground`**
   - **Location:** [AnimatedThemeBackground.java](file:///C:/Users/wmako/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/Plus/app/src/main/java/com/lenerd46/spotifyplus/theme/AnimatedThemeBackground.java#L109-L132) & [FrostedBackdrop.java](file:///C:/Users/wmako/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/Plus/app/src/main/java/com/lenerd46/spotifyplus/theme/FrostedBackdrop.java#L32-L45)
   - **Problem:**
     - `layoutListener` runs `updateChrome()` on every `OnGlobalLayoutListener` callback across Spotify, walking the entire view tree (`discoverSurfaces`) and calling `getResources().getIdentifier(...)` repeatedly without caching resource IDs.
     - `FrostedBackdrop.draw()` draws the entire `LyricsBackgroundView` into a software `Canvas` every 66ms (`source.draw(sampleCanvas)`), and `AnimatedThemeBackground.sampleBackdropColor()` draws it *again* into another software `Canvas` every 250ms (`lines 213-223`),even though `LyricsBackgroundView` only renders a single OpenGL/AGSL `TextureView` that cannot be captured by `View.draw(Canvas)` (so `sampleCanvas` just renders the fallback/background color while wasting CPU on box blurs!).

9. **Continuous 1-Second Polling + 20 Delayed Layout Passes in `NowPlayingControlsHook`**
   - **Location:** [NowPlayingViewHook.java](file:///C:/Users/wmako/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/Plus/app/src/main/java/com/lenerd46/spotifyplus/hooks/NowPlayingViewHook.java#L660-L688)
   - **Problem:** When the Now Playing screen opens, `watchNowPlayingLayout` schedules **20** `postDelayed` calls (`0ms, 100ms, ..., 1900ms`) AND an infinite 1000ms loop (`refresh`) that re-runs `applyLayout(root)` every second, plus on every `OnLayoutChangeListener` event. Every `applyLayout` does uncached `getResources().getIdentifier(...)` lookups and full recursive view-tree searches (`findByDescription`, `findArtwork`).
   - **Fix:** Cache all Spotify resource IDs in static fields once, debounce layout applications to a single frame via `postOnAnimation`, and remove the infinite 1-second polling loop.

10. **500ms Reflection/Regex Polling Heartbeats in `AnimatedAlbumArtwork` and `ImmersiveAnimatedArtwork`**
    - **Location:** [AnimatedAlbumArtwork.java](file:///C:/Users/wmako/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/Plus/app/src/main/java/com/lenerd46/spotifyplus/hooks/AnimatedAlbumArtwork.java#L403-L426) & [ImmersiveAnimatedArtwork.java](file:///C:/Users/wmako/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/Plus/app/src/main/java/com/lenerd46/spotifyplus/hooks/ImmersiveAnimatedArtwork.java#L417-L441)
    - **Problem:** Both hooks run a 500ms loop calling `References.getTrackTitle(lpparm, bridge)`, which performs reflection + regex matching on Spotify's state object every 500ms, even though `BeautifulLyricsHook` already hooks Spotify's track-change event and notifies listeners via `References.notifyTrackStateChanged()`.

---

### 3. Startup Delay & Global Hook Overhead

11. **Heavy Synchronous DexKit Scans on Cold Start (`Application.attach`)**
    - **Location:** [XposedLoader.java](file:///C:/Users/wmako/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/Plus/app/src/main/java/com/lenerd46/spotifyplus/XposedLoader.java#L140-L174)
    - **Problem:** Every cold start creates a `DexKitBridge` and runs 15+ hooks that scan the entire Spotify APK synchronously on the main thread before Spotify's UI can start, adding significant startup delay. Additionally, `bridge.close()` is never called.
    - **Fix:** Cache resolved class/method/field names in `SharedPreferences` keyed by `(spotifyVersionCode, moduleVersion)` so subsequent launches hook immediately in <5ms without initializing DexKit.

12. **5 Separate `LayoutInflater.inflate` Hooks Calling `getResourceName()` on Every View Inflation**
    - **Location:** `AnimatedAlbumArtwork`, `ImmersiveAnimatedArtwork`, `NowPlayingViewHook` (`NowPlayingSwipeHook`), `ThemeHook`, and `TestingHook`.
    - **Problem:** Every `LayoutInflater.inflate` call in Spotify triggers 5 separate Xposed hooks, each calling `ctx.getResources().getResourceName(layoutId)` / `getResourceEntryName(layoutId)` (IPC/string allocation).
    - **Fix:** Resolve the target integer layout IDs once via `getIdentifier(...)` (cached) and compare `int layoutId == cachedId` in a single consolidated hook.

13. **Global `View` Constructor Hook in `ThemeHook`**
    - **Location:** [ThemeHook.java](file:///C:/Users/wmako/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/Plus/app/src/main/java/com/lenerd46/spotifyplus/hooks/ThemeHook.java#L1601-L1657)
    - **Problem:** When the theme hook is initialized, it hooks `View(Context, AttributeSet, int, int)`—which executes for **every single View constructed in Spotify**—and inserts into a synchronized `WeakHashMap`. If theming is disabled (`theme_enabled == false`), it still runs on every View constructor just to early-return after reading `SharedPreferences`.

---

### 4. UX Glitches, Bugs & Memory Leaks

14. **Broken Subpage Exit Animation & Stuck Back-Button State in Settings (`RemoveCreateButtonHook`)**
    - **Location:** [RemoveCreateButtonHook.java](file:///C:/Users/wmako/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/Plus/app/src/main/java/com/lenerd46/spotifyplus/hooks/RemoveCreateButtonHook.java#L285-L334) & [lines 1324–1331](file:///C:/Users/wmako/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/Plus/app/src/main/java/com/lenerd46/spotifyplus/hooks/RemoveCreateButtonHook.java#L1324-L1331)
    - **Problem:**
      - `animatePageOut(View page, Runnable onComplete)` animates `page.animate().alpha(1.0f)` instead of `0.0f` (and no `translationX`), and all callers pass `(ViewGroup) parent` (which is the entire window `DecorView`!) instead of `view`! As a result, pressing Back in any SpotifyPlus sub-settings page freezes for 150ms and then pops the view out abruptly.
      - Clicking the top-left toolbar back button in sub-settings (lines 330, 575, 874, 923, 991) never resets `currentDetailedSettingsPage.set(null)`, so the next hardware Back press is swallowed!

15. **Saved Lyrics Font Preference Ignored on App Launch + `WeakReference<Typeface>` Causes Font Loss & Unexpected Navigation**
    - **Location:** [XposedLoader.java](file:///C:/Users/wmako/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/Plus/app/src/main/java/com/lenerd46/spotifyplus/XposedLoader.java#L112-L137) & [References.java](file:///C:/Users/wmako/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/Plus/app/src/main/java/com/lenerd46/spotifyplus/References.java#L41)
    - **Problem:**
      - In `Activity.onCreate`, `XposedLoader` hardcodes `"fonts/sf-pro-display-bold.ttf"` instead of reading the user's `"lyrics_font"` setting (`default`, `spotify`, or `apple`).
      - `References.beautifulFont` is stored only in a `WeakReference<Typeface>` with no strong reference anywhere. When the GC collects that `Typeface`, two bugs happen: (a) lyrics suddenly lose their custom font, and (b) the next `Activity.onCreate` sees `beautifulFont == null` and re-runs `navigateToStartupPage(activity)` and `checkForUpdates(activity)` mid-session!

16. **No In-Memory Caching for Lyrics or Album Artwork + Per-Request `OkHttpClient` Creation**
    - **Location:** [BeautifulLyricsHook.java](file:///C:/Users/wmako/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/Plus/app/src/main/java/com/lenerd46/spotifyplus/hooks/BeautifulLyricsHook.java#L1541), [line 1861](file:///C:/Users/wmako/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/Plus/app/src/main/java/com/lenerd46/spotifyplus/hooks/BeautifulLyricsHook.java#L1861), [line 3035](file:///C:/Users/wmako/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/Plus/app/src/main/java/com/lenerd46/spotifyplus/hooks/BeautifulLyricsHook.java#L3035)
    - **Problem:** Closing and reopening the lyrics view (or replaying a track) re-downloads the lyrics JSON and re-downloads the album artwork `Bitmap` over the network every time, creating a fresh `new OkHttpClient()` (with its own connection pool and thread pool) on each call.
    - **Fix:** Use a single shared `OkHttpClient` instance and add an `LruCache<String, String>` for lyrics JSON and `LruCache<String, Bitmap>` for artwork bitmaps.

This confirms the display error is due to an integer truncation issue with custom timers.

### Root Causes & Fixes

1. **Sleep timer (`90` min / `1.5 hours` showing up as `1 hour`)**
   - **Cause:** `SleepTimerState.minutes` converts both `90` minutes and `1.5` hours to `90` minutes cleanly, and [NativeSleepTimerMenuHook.java](file:///C:/Users/wmako/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/Plus/app/src/main/java/com/lenerd46/spotifyplus/hooks/NativeSleepTimerMenuHook.java#L43) merges those presets into Spotify's native Compose sleep timer sheet. However, Spotify's native `renderLabel` integer-divides durations `>= 60` into whole hours (`90 / 60 = 1` -> `"1 hour"`), and the non-whole-hour plural override in [SleepTimerHook.java](file:///C:/Users/wmako/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/Plus/app/api2-source/app/src/main/java/com/lenerd/spotifyplus/module/hooks/SleepTimerHook.java#L166-L185) previously only tracked extension-added rows (`WeakRows`)—ignoring native presets injected by `NativeSleepTimerMenuHook`.
   - **Fix:** Added `SleepTimerHook.trackNativeDuration(option, minutes)` using shared `WeakIdentityMap` lookups propagated through `createState` / `updateState` -> `renderLabel` -> `quantityString` (using `context_menu_sleep_timer_mins` with `"N minutes"` fallback whenever `minutes >= 60 && minutes % 60 != 0`), and wired [NativeSleepTimerMenuHook.java](file:///C:/Users/wmako/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/Plus/app/src/main/java/com/lenerd46/spotifyplus/hooks/NativeSleepTimerMenuHook.java#L43) to register created native duration options.

2. **`Queue & Bookmarks+` -> `"which playlist plays this song"` (`expected receiver type of p.pgz, but got p.rgz`)**
   - **Cause:** [Api2Runtime.java](file:///C:/Users/wmako/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/Plus/app/src/main/java/com/lenerd46/spotifyplus/api2/Api2Runtime.java#L167) assigned `PlayerHook.core = NextUpQueue.currentRepository()` (`p.rgz`), while [PlayerHook.java](file:///C:/Users/wmako/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/Plus/app/src/main/java/com/lenerd/spotifyplus/module/hooks/PlayerHook.java#L13-L74) did not hook `PlayerSymbols.DISPATCHER_CONSTRUCTOR` / `PlayerSymbols.DISPATCH` (`p.pgz`). Calling `PlayerSymbols.DISPATCHER_CLIENT.get(core)` inside [SpotifyServices.java](file:///C:/Users/wmako/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/Plus/app/api2-source/app/src/main/java/com/lenerd/spotifyplus/module/scripting/SpotifyServices.java#L267-L295) then failed with `expected receiver type of p.pgz, but got p.rgz`.
   - **Fix:**
     - Hooked `PlayerSymbols.DISPATCHER_CONSTRUCTOR`, `PlayerSymbols.DISPATCH`, and `PlayerSymbols.CONTEXT_PLAYER_CONSTRUCTOR` in [PlayerHook.java](file:///C:/Users/wmako/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/Plus/app/src/main/java/com/lenerd/spotifyplus/module/hooks/PlayerHook.java#L21-L74) to capture `p.pgz` into `core` and notify `SpotifyServices.onCoreReady()`.

export function parseReleaseDate(input) {
  if (!input) return null;
  if (typeof input === "object") {
    const year = finite(input.year);
    if (!year || year < 1900 || year > 2100) return null;
    const month = finite(input.month);
    const day = finite(input.day);
    return {
      year,
      month: month && month >= 1 && month <= 12 ? month : null,
      day: day && day >= 1 && day <= 31 ? day : null,
    };
  }
  const str = String(input).trim();
  const match = /^(\d{4})(?:-(\d{1,2})(?:-(\d{1,2}))?)?/.exec(str);
  if (!match) return null;
  const year = Number(match[1]);
  const month = match[2] ? Number(match[2]) : null;
  const day = match[3] ? Number(match[3]) : null;
  return {
    year,
    month: month && month >= 1 && month <= 12 ? month : null,
    day: day && day >= 1 && day <= 31 ? day : null,
  };
}
